Cap is a greater-of construct: "the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000" — not a plain 12 months' fees cap

offending_extra_words: Customer's obligation to pay all amounts due under this Agreement is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
reasons: The 21.1 edit alone completes the preferred cap: the greater-of construct, the exact lowercase fee basis anchored to the claim, and the USD 1,000,000 floor, with mutuality and the 21.2/21.3 carve-outs left untouched.

The second operation was unnecessary and is adverse to us. The original already satisfied the preferred element that Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages'; replacing "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" with "all amounts due under this Agreement" strips the Customer-side qualifiers so disputed amounts and amounts for non-conforming Services also sit outside the cap. Minimality fails on this expansion.

Fallback is not independently satisfied because the cap is a greater-of rather than a flat 12 months' fees cap; that is immaterial here since the locked target is preferred and preferred is fully met.
Recommendation: revert 21.3 to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" and keep only the 21.1 replacement.
